result.question: What did Jehoiada give commanders?

readings.answer: the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD
readings.support: the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: Verse 11:10 states, “the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields of King David,” matching the key; adding “from the house of the LORD” is acceptable extra detail.

result.reason: 2 Kings 11:10 explicitly says Jehoiada gave the commanders the spears and shields of King David.
